survey: A folding camping chair in three-quarter view, seen from a little above and to the front-left. The green fabric backrest stands nearly upright between two grey tube uprights. Its stitched border and printed tent-and-campfire logo lie flat on the cloth and follow its slight curve. The green seat sling hangs between the side rails, and its top face shows from above at the same angle as the floor. The front edge of the seat rises gently to the right, matching the front line between the two feet. Two orange armrests sit on curved tube posts. Each shows its top face from above and recedes along the chair's depth axis, so they agree with the seat. The front X-brace lies in the chair's front plane and crosses at a central hub. The hub, joints and feet line up with the seat's front edge. The back-left leg drops to a foot set higher up the floor, which correctly places it further back. The grey foot caps are short cylinders seen from slightly above, and their ellipses match the floor angle. All visible feet touch the flat floor, and the soft shadow falls back-left along that floor. Verticals stay vertical, and the receding edges of the seat, armrests and floor agree on one camera. The back-right leg is hidden behind the front frame, which is plausible from this angle.
